About the Bike to Work Wednesdays group ride

Not a group ride in the usual sense: a weekly summer bike-commute meetup. Ride to a different bikeable spot in Jackson each Wednesday morning for free coffee and breakfast with other people on bikes, then carry on to work. Run by the town's pathways nonprofit.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
